Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: Digital business register via computerized RCCM (Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier) deployed; online guichet unique at mali.eregistrations.org for company creation in 72h.
revision_notes: Confirmed. The originally cited OHADA source (ohada.org) is a bare video listing with no substantive detail, and the cited mali.eregistrations.org portal returned a server error on fetch, so both were replaced with fuller sources. OHADA.com reporting confirms computerisation of the RCCM was officially launched on 18 September 2017 in Bamako, with equipment supplied by OHADA. The API-Mali Guichet Unique (single window) and the official Malian e-administration portal both describe an operational, still-current 72-hour company registration procedure (RCCM certificate, NIMA tax ID) processed centrally through API-Mali. No evidence of full nationwide/all-jurisdiction deployment was found, so 'Partially deployed' is the best-supported code; 'Fully deployed nationwide' is not supported.
revised_comments: Mali's Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM) has been computerised since September 2017, with equipment and software provided through an OHADA-backed modernisation programme launched in Bamako. Business registration is centralised through the API-Mali Guichet Unique (single window), which issues the RCCM certificate, tax identification number (NIMA) and related documents within 72 hours of application, with online submission available via the eRegistrations platform. The digital register operates through this centralised single-window process rather than uniformly across all commercial jurisdictions, consistent with partial rather than full nationwide deployment.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more social protection registers?
Comments: Unified Social Registry (RSU) exists: national database for social protection beneficiaries, contributory and non-contributory; institutionalized by presidential decree May 2022; rsu.gouv.ml operational.
revision_notes: Confirmed. rsu.gouv.ml is live and describes the Registre Social Unifié (RSU) as a national beneficiary database for both contributory and non-contributory social protection, institutionalised by Decree N°2022-0276, with enumeration campaigns having covered households in all regions (613 communes reported in a 2020 emergency cash transfer round). The World Bank's Sahel Adaptive Social Protection Program (SASPP) Mali page, updated for FY25 (July 2024-June 2025), describes ongoing 'foundational work in policy, systems, and diagnostics' with FY26 plans for 'consolidating these gains through implementation, system strengthening', indicating the RSU is operational but still being extended and strengthened rather than a mature, fully deployed nationwide system. 'Partially deployed' is confirmed; there is no evidence supporting an upgrade to 'Fully deployed nationwide'.
revised_comments: Mali maintains a Registre Social Unifié (RSU), a national information system holding a beneficiary database for social protection covering both contributory and non-contributory schemes, institutionalised under Decree N°2022-0276. The register has recorded households across all regions of the country through successive enumeration campaigns, including registration drives linked to the government's emergency cash transfer programme. Under the World Bank-supported Sahel Adaptive Social Protection Program, Mali's most recent programme year focused on strengthening RSU policy, systems and diagnostics, with further system strengthening and implementation planned ahead, reflecting a functioning but still-maturing register rather than a fully deployed nationwide system.
